Over view of the Departmental profile

The Manipuri Department of Lala Rural College was started in the year 1973. Sri T.
Nimaichand Singha was the first teacher of the Department. Along with him Sri L. Wakching
was another prominent teacher who served the Department for a very long period of time.
Although these two teachers have retired, they will always be remembered for their valuable
contribution to the Department. During their tenure there was a huge increase in the number of
students opting Manipuri as a subject. Initially, Manipuri was taught as MIL and Elective
subjects for both H.S. and T.D. C. levels. Subsequently, Honours in Manipuri was introduced
and many students passing out from this College with Manipuri Hons went on to study Masters,
M.Phil and P.hD. The Dapartment is presently being run by two efficient and hardworking
teachers namely Dr. L Musindra Singha and Dr. O. Usharani Singha. Revered teachers, scholars
and Manipuri Literary organizations have been giving their utmost support in preserving the
Department.

 VISION OF THE DEPARTMENT:

    To impart the better knowledge to the students about the mother tongue and to make
     them understand about the importance of this language.
    To promote Manipuri language and literature of academically to highlight the
     relationship between Manipuri language and literature of other languages of India.
    To promote scientific analysis of Manipuri Folklore and Folk culture as a part of the
     syllabus.
    To introduce Manipuri language, literature and cultural heritage to the students of this
     region.
     Mission of the Department:
    To promote the value of Language, Literature and Culture.
    To prepare students in such a way that, after completion of the Three-year degree course,
     he / she is equipped with a good knowledge of his/ her own identity and becomes on asset
     to the society and the nation.

Future plan :

    Departmental Magazine entitled ‘Tamna’ to be published as usual.
    To organized a departmental Seminar.
    To arrange one or two special lectures on relevant topics.

Departmental SWOC

   •   Strength: Co operation among the language departments i.e. English, Bengali, would be
       our strength.

   •   Weakness: Shortage of teacher is the Major problem in our Department. Presently we
       have only one permanents post and one non sanctioned teachers with home. We are
       notable to new activities in our Department.

   •   Opportunity: Literature is the mirror of history culture and society. So our responsibility
       is not to teach the students in the class at the same time We are to involve ourselves with
       the greatest society in and around us.

   •   Challenges: Presently our Department is performing better result in Assam University.
       We are to go forward with the present positive result and in future motto is to be the best
       Department in the college.

B.A MANIPURI

Programme of outcome:

The programme of outcome in Manipuri subjects it makes the student capable for the literary and
cultural context. It helps the students to read text closely, paying attention the themes linguistic
and stylistic variation to identify the ideas that behind the outcome of literary. The students can
evaluate the impact relevance of the production to locate its significance students should
understand and respect the diversities in literary text. At the last of the programme students
empowers to read, write and speak on various personal arguments.

Communication is effective key outcomes of the programme. The students should express their
ideas clearly speech and writing. The students would learn many different writings of formats-
literary, creative, business and technical that enables to communicate in any field.
